GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, improved into race rounding turn, worked through gaps in field mostly Two Wide until being blocked and baulked and Checked at 100m, Made Some Ground to the line # back/ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Steadied after improving onto heels rounding the home turn. Near the 100m was checked outwards after laying in onto heels. Bumped another runner passing the 50m and again close to the finish line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down last but only trailing 6.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out past centre of track and Made Ground in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Pacifiers FIRST TIME) [Stewards: COT - To settle further back from the Wide gate. Settled rearward.] # back/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics - to settle further back from the wide gate, settled at the rear of the field. Shortly after straightening was obliged to shift out around a number of sets of heels to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, blocked early in straight, clear running presented from 250m but couldn't come on and faded the last 150m. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to lead on fence by a head, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed 150m and faded to the line. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # led/faded last 150m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths locked away nowhere to go until the Straightening Up immed asked to go, Kept Trying 1st sat 2nd - # Sound

Went back from the gate settled second last in the small field 6 Lengths (1000m), still back there To The Turn & into the Straight given a crack, passed nothing home, lost further Ground # never close

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, little change to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered widest Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # slow out/weakened
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd fence 2 Lengths 600m 3rd fence 2 Lengths Straightened Up 2nd rails tired final 100m # every chance/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. Near the 1000m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Touch slow away. Recovered & raced Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground quickly until eased down in straight. Rider - raced like a tired horse/vetted clear. # Wide & tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide, without cover, in the early stages before obtaining cover in middle stages. Rdr stated mount was under full pressure from 500m & was very disapp in run to line. Rdr added mount raced like a tired horse. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 11 Lengths on fence, Checked first turn, railed to 10 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin.  Approaching the first turn was checked after pulling its way up onto the heels of a runner as it shifted in. Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.
